description: Golden wire contract for PostDeploy Observe and Measure ingest. The Phoenix product owns these bytes and the server parsers that validate them. Every SDK under sdks/ pins this version and the per-item checksums below in its own code and reads this directory directly, so a fixture change must update the product parser and all three SDK pins in the same pull request. Path-filtered CI runs the server anchor and every SDK suite on any change to this set.
